ste_simon.origin: new pure-Torch hard-forward sigmoid-leaf STE over the current public SIMON cone; no archived model, solver or historical learned assignment used
ste_simon.base: models/structured_simon.py public wiring and independent random parameter initialization, scaled0.05
ste_simon.learning: ordinary TRAIN BCE backward and Adam updates; biased straight-through surrogate, not a true discrete derivative
ste_simon.forward: Boolean unknown constant thresholds, exact public AND/XOR, fixed +/-2 logits in train and eval
ste_simon.forbidden_sources_absent: no actual key, key_seed, true round keys, real traces, TEST fitting, SAT or enumeration results
ste_simon.claims: structured neural/gradient parameter learning, not generic MLP, symbolic search or full key recovery
ste_simon.task: absolute ciphertext single-bit prediction, differential prediction explicitly deferred
